name: within_group
docs:
A clause used with certain aggregate functions to control the ordering
within grouped sets before the function is applied.

Syntax:
```plaintext
<aggregate_function>(expression) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY key [ASC | DESC], ...)
```
